documentation.content:
**A Milton health endpoint is failing from at least two regions.** One email per incident; it closes 30 minutes after the checks pass again.

Checks: `https://app.meetmilton.com/health`, `https://mcp.meetmilton.com/health`, `https://auth.meetmilton.com/api/auth/ok`, every 5 minutes from Oregon, Iowa and Virginia, 10 s timeout. The incident names the host.

Check first:
1. `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' https://<host>/<path>` from your machine.
2. Did a release just move traffic? `gcloud run services describe <service> --project=milton-510506 --region=us-east4 --format='yaml(status.traffic)'`. If so, roll back per server/deploy/README.md, "Release verification and rollback".
3. The edge: certificate map `milton-mcp`, URL map `milton-mcp`, DNS A records at 35.227.244.36 (Cloudflare, DNS-only).

Threshold: failing from 2 or more of 3 regions for 10 minutes (two consecutive 5-minute rounds). Reason: one region's probe path can fail on its own; two rounds rule out a single dropped probe. Uptime conditions are never charged.

conditions.displayName: health check failing from ≥ 2 regions for 10 min

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type = "monitoring.googleapis.com/uptime_check/check_passed" AND resource.type = "uptime_url" AND resource.labels.host = one_of("app.meetmilton.com", "mcp.meetmilton.com", "auth.meetmilton.com")
